bank_accounts.sql:
CREATE TABLE bank_accounts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bank TEXT NOT NULL, identity_scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_scope IN ('bank','profile')),
 profile_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source_key TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL,
 scale INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scale BETWEEN 0 AND 12), label TEXT NOT NULL, masked_number TEXT NOT NULL,
 supported INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supported IN (0,1)), unsupported_reason TEXT,
 selection TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unconfigured' CHECK(selection IN ('unconfigured','enabled','ignored')),
 zenmoney_account_id TEXT, import_start TEXT, settings_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(settings_version>=0),
 last_complete_end TEXT,
 CHECK((identity_scope='bank' AND profile_key='') OR (identity_scope='profile' AND profile_key<>'')),
 CHECK((selection='enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NOT NULL AND import_start IS NOT NULL)
    OR (selection<>'enabled' AND zenmoney_account_id IS NULL)),
 UNIQUE(bank,identity_scope,profile_key,source_key,currency))

triggers.name: processing_terminal_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER processing_terminal_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_processing
 WHEN OLD.state IN ('delivered','suppressed')
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Processed bank operation cannot be deleted'); END

triggers.name: processing_terminal_update
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER processing_terminal_update BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON bank_processing
 WHEN (OLD.state='suppressed' AND NEW.state<>'suppressed')
   OR (OLD.state='delivered' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('delivered','suppressed'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Processed bank operation cannot be reset'); END

 local_date TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT, direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('expense','income')),

 description TEXT NOT NULL, beneficiary_account TEXT, beneficiary_name TEXT,

triggers.name: interval_identity
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER interval_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON capture_intervals
 WHEN NEW.id<>OLD.id OR NEW.job_id<>OLD.job_id OR NEW.account_id<>OLD.account_id
 OR NEW.settings_version<>OLD.settings_version OR NEW.start_date<>OLD.start_date OR NEW.end_date<>OLD.end_date
 OR (OLD.state='complete' AND (NEW.state<>'complete' OR NEW.total_pages IS NOT OLD.total_pages OR NEW.total_records IS NOT OLD.total_records))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Capture interval identity and completion evidence are immutable'); END

triggers.name: interval_scope

 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Interval must belong to a job account snapshot'); END

triggers.name: delivery_immutable
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON deliveries
 WHEN NEW.zen_id<>OLD.zen_id OR NEW.bank_id<>OLD.bank_id OR NEW.ever_attempted<OLD.ever_attempted
   OR (OLD.ever_attempted=1 AND NEW.payload<>OLD.payload)
   OR (OLD.state='suppressed' AND NEW.state<>'suppressed')
   OR (OLD.state='delivered' AND NEW.state NOT IN ('delivered','suppressed'))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery identity or attempted payload is immutable'); END

triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_preserved BEFORE DELETE ON deliveries
 WHEN OLD.ever_attempted=1 OR OLD.state IN ('delivered','suppressed')
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Attempted delivery cannot be deleted'); END

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_proof
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_proof BEFORE INSERT ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_records r JOIN capture_intervals i ON i.id=r.interval_id
   JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.id=r.bank_id JOIN job_accounts a ON a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id
   WHERE r.interval_id=NEW.interval_id AND r.bank_id=NEW.bank_id AND r.revision=NEW.revision AND i.state='complete'
     AND a.settings_version=NEW.settings_version AND a.target_id=NEW.target_id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery needs completed capture and job authorization'); END

triggers.name: delivery_authorization_update_proof
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER delivery_authorization_update_proof BEFORE UPDATE ON delivery_authorizations
 WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_records r JOIN capture_intervals i ON i.id=r.interval_id
   JOIN bank_transactions b ON b.id=r.bank_id JOIN job_accounts a ON a.job_id=NEW.job_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id
   WHERE r.interval_id=NEW.interval_id AND r.bank_id=NEW.bank_id AND r.revision=NEW.revision AND i.state='complete'
     AND a.settings_version=NEW.settings_version AND a.target_id=NEW.target_id)
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Delivery needs completed capture and job authorization'); END

policy.activation: architecture.md participant handoff for live migration; explicit archive-only recovery is distinct

canonical_encoding.dataset_digest: SHA256 of compact JSON descriptor plus LF; descriptor fixed property order: financial_schema_version,dataset_id,zenmoney_identity,required_features,tables; table fixed property order: name,filename,columns,rows,bytes,sha256; table list sorted by UTF-8 filename, owner_ids/features sorted by UTF-8 bytes; excludes producer/archive time/session IDs
canonical_encoding.empty_table: zero bytes; SHA256 of empty bytes
canonical_encoding.format: UTF-8 compact JSON, LF terminator, no BOM, no lone Unicode surrogates
canonical_encoding.integer_scalar: canonical signed decimal string; no -0, exponent or leading zero
canonical_encoding.row_order: primary-key tuple; integers compared numerically, text by UTF-8 byte order, blob by decoded bytes; NULL first only where logically allowed
canonical_encoding.strings: JSON escaping for control characters, quote and backslash; Unicode otherwise literal

normalizations.capture_jobs.lease_expires_at: null; preserve lease_epoch as audit only
normalizations.category_predictions: invalidate derived applicability after source generation change
normalizations.delivery_authorizations: attempted immutable; only unattempted source binding may be revalidated
normalizations.service_meta: explicit allowlist; instance_id becomes lineage, not installation identity
normalizations.source_capture_leases: empty executable set after quiescence; orphan locks cause export validation failure
normalizations.source_schema_migrations.backup_path: null; host path is not portable
normalizations.zen_mirror_state: preserve audit; destination needs_full=1 ready=0 fresh cursor context

policy.zip_members: manifest.json and exactly the declared table files

manifest.title: Portable archive manifest; semantic table/identity validation remains mandatory

format.manifest_timestamp: UTC RFC3339 with Z and up to six fractional digits
format.row_encoding: compact UTF-8 JSON plus LF; exact re-encoding required
format.row_order: strict primary-key order; integers numeric and text UTF-8 bytes
format.graph_validation: required separately before import or activation; format validity alone grants no authority

legacy_objects.name: split_links
legacy_objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW split_links AS SELECT b.bank_id,z.zen_id
            FROM reconciliation_bank_members b JOIN reconciliation_groups g ON g.id=b.group_id
            JOIN reconciliation_zen_members z ON z.group_id=g.id WHERE g.kind='split'
